titulo_es.@es: Leer un informe breve de trabajo

열 건은 서류가 부족해서 다시.en: Fragment of the phrase: A hundred requests arrived. We have to recheck ten because there are no documents.

확인해야 해요.en: Fragment of the phrase: A hundred requests arrived. We have to recheck ten because there are no documents.

결과는 금요일에 공유할 예정이에요.es: Está previsto compartir el resultado el viernes
결과는 금요일에 공유할 예정이에요.en: It is planned to share the result on Friday

texto.@es: Un informe resume el resultado, el problema pendiente y el siguiente paso; localiza cada parte en vez de tratar todo como una conclusión.
texto.@en: A report summarizes the outcome, the outstanding problem and the next step; it locates each party rather than treating everything as a conclusion.
